body:
## Fix

F1. Keep installed local deck row key, name, and card lists consistent with the immutable resolved deck used to start the duel. Previously, a save between repository list/load could show one revision and start another.
F2. Add regression simulating revision 3 listed while revision 4 resolves.

## Validation

V1. Regression reproduced failure before fix; green after fix.
V2. Parent reran installed Free Play unit/component tests, selectable decks, and FreePlayMatchSetup: 4 files, 40 tests passed.
V3. Worker typecheck: 0 errors, 4 existing Svelte warnings. Changed-file ESLint/Prettier and diff check passed.
V4. Parent reviewed production diff, resolver contract, test assertions, and staged paths. No blocking finding.

## Limits

L1. Full repository/browser suites not run locally; CI remains separate.
L2. Sort timestamp still comes from initial list and can lag until refresh during a concurrent save; displayed deck identity/cards and start payload are consistent.
title: fix(battle): keep installed deck rows revision-consistent
